assertions.evidence: src/incident-urgency.ts defines URGENCY_QUESTION with type: "score" and a five-level criteria array (URGENCY_RUBRIC), not a choice over digits.
rateIncidentUrgency derives urgency in code via toLevel(answer.score), and sortIncidentReportsByUrgency sorts by rating.urgency; no second model call is made.
The Decisions API request sets state: { report_text: report.text, affected_service: report.affectedService }, keeping report text and service as separate named fields.
